content: Řeḥkamet n řehna i dd ɣa yasen
“Ad dd-teffeɣ Tseṭṭa zi jjdeɛ n Yassa u Taɣeddut zeg iẓewran nnes ad dd-tawi řɣiǧet.
Ad xas yarsa Arruḥ n SIDI, Arruḥ n tiɣit d řeɛqeř, Arruḥ n ccwar d jjehd, Arruḥ n tussna d tiggʷudi zi SIDI.
Arḍa nnes ad yiři di tiggʷudi n SIDI. War icarreɛ ɛlaḥsab min ttwařant tiṭṭawin nnes, war iḥekkem ɛlaḥsab min ttesřan imezzuɣen nnes.
Ad icarreɛ imuqřiřen s tsegda u ad iḥkem imwaḍɛen n temmurt s řḥeqq, maca tammurt ad tt iwwet s uzeǧaḍ n uqemmum nnes u s usuḍi n uqemmum nnes ad ineɣ aɛeffan.
Tasegda ad tiři d abyas n tejɛinnatin nnes u tidett d abyas x tmeṣṣaḍin nnes.
Ad izdeɣ wuccen ɣar izmar, aɣiras ad ijen ɣar iɣayḍ ameẓyan. Aɛejmi d wayrad ameẓyan d řmař iṣeḥḥen ad iřin munen uca aḥenjir ameẓyan ad ten indeh.
Tafunast d ddub ad hdan jmiɛ, uca imeẓyanen nsen ad jnen ɣar wayawya uca ayrad ad yecc řum am ufunas.
Aḥḍiḍ ad yarr mezři zzat i wexbuc n třefsa u anibu i kksen zeg uṭṭuḍ, ad isswiẓẓeḍ afus nnes ɣar warzam n tfawt n weḥfur n ufiɣar.
War tteggen řɣar u war tteggen areddeǧ x wedrar inu iqeddsen marra, maɣar tammurt teccur s tussna n SIDI am mammec dřen waman tisi n řebḥar.
Deg wass nni ad ibedd Weẓwar n Yassa am tɛeǧant i weyduden. Ɣares ad sseqsan řegnus uca amcan n arraḥet nnes ad yiři icewwar.”
“Deg wass nni ad issgeɛɛed Sidi inu afus nnes ict n twařa nneɣnit, ḥima ad isellek min iqqimen n řgens nnes zi Accur, Miṣra, Fatrus, Kuc, Ɛilam, Cinɛar d Ḥamat u zi tegzirin n řebḥar.
Netta ad issbedd taɛeǧant i řegnus u ad ijarw ɛawed imenneɛraq n Israil, ḥima ad issmun inni ittwazeǧɛen zi Yahuda zi arebɛa n tɣemmura n temmurt.
Xenni ad iggʷej wasam n Ifrayim u inni iḥeṣṣaren Yahuda ad ttwaqeḍɛen. Ifrayim war ittisem ɛad zi Yahuda u Yahuda war iḥeṣṣar ɛad Ifrayim.
Ad ffɣen ɣar řɣarb axmi ṭṭawen x tɣarḍin n Ifilisṭiniyyen uca munen ad keccḍen ayt n ccarq. Ad sswiẓẓḍen ifassen nsen ɣar Idum d Mu’ab uca ayt n Ɛammun ad asen ṭṭaɛen.

Ad iḥarrem SIDI iřes n řebḥar n Miṣra uca Netta ad issgeɛɛed afus nnes x yeɣzar n Lfuraṭ s uḥaduq n Arruḥ nnes u ad t iwwet ař ɣa idweř sebɛa n tɣezratin, uca ad yarr aqa zemmaren ad kken x webrid s sandaliyat.
Ad din yiři webrid iseggmen i min iqqimen n řgens nnes nni i ɣa iceṭṭen zi Accur, am mammec tuɣa iǧa webrid i Israil umi dd-igeɛɛed zi Miṣra.”
